title: Priority-lane mapping and GPU affinity scenario simulator
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight scenario simulator that ingests customer workload profiles (arrival rates, latency targets, reserved throughput needs, preemption tolerance) and outputs prioritized routing lanes, GPU-family affinity recommendations, and scaling policy suggestions. This artifact will be used by Solutions, Sales, and Capacity Concierge teams during enterprise intake to validate SLA feasibility and produce a first-pass reservation proposal. The goal is not to replace the full recommender service but to provide a reproducible, auditable, explainable decision artifact that accelerates triage and reduces back-and-forth with customers.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator accepts a JSON or CSV workload profile and returns a lane-to-GPU-family mapping and scaling policy CSV
Recommended configuration includes: lane priority, reserved throughput (rps or tokens/sec), desired GPU family, min/max instance bounds, and burst quota
Recommendations adhere to configured SLA constraints: latency p50/p95 targets and preemption tolerance thresholds
Includes three canonical customer scenarios (low-latency high-cost, throughput-driven low-latency, bursty telemetry) with example outputs
Deliver unit tests and a short how-to doc for Concierge and Solutions teams
UX spreadsheet for manual review is available in Drive and links on the intake form
decisions: Start with a deterministic rule-based engine (heuristics + cost model) before investing in ML-based recommendations
GPU families prioritized: H100 (latency-sensitive), A100 (balanced), L4 (cost-sensitive/burstable). Map affinity by compute/latency profile and batchability
Priority lanes: P0 (latency SLO), P1 (throughput SLO), P2 (best-effort/burst), with explicit fallback lane routing
Scaling policies will include headroom margin and burst credits; autoscaling thresholds expressed in tokens/sec and queue depth
Expose explainability artifacts (why this GPU, why this lane) as text snippets for customer communications
